name: Jin, Zealous Maverick: On Enter, this champion's next attack gets +1 POWER and wakes it up
notes: A real level-up event is required to fire a champion's own On Enter (a static CardID patch does not fire triggers, per kongming-wayward-maven-enter-shifting-currents). The starting champion is patched to Jin, Fate Defiant (level 1) so the real level-up reaches Jin, Zealous Maverick (level 2, memory cost 2, listed in the deck's Material section so GetLevelUpMaterialIndices finds it). On Enter tags TurnEffects with '5ramr16052' (GeneratedMacroCode.php:9805-9809); on the champion's next attack, CombatLogic.php:1796-1801 consumes that flag into '5ramr16052_POWER' (+1 POWER, GameLogic.php:12244) and calls WakeupCard. Two engine quirks discovered via a throwaway debug harness (DevTools/debug_zealous.php, now deleted): (1) resolving the MAT-phase choice by leveling up lands directly in MAIN phase with an empty decision queue, unlike declining -- no extra pass needed; (2) Zealous Maverick has 0 base POWER, so BeginCombatPhase's power>0 gate (checked before the On Attack trigger fires) makes the attack illegal without a weapon -- Steel Halberd is seeded as the equipped weapon, which ALSO re-indexes the field: the level-up re-adds the champion at the END of the field array rather than in place, so Steel Halberd becomes myField-0 and the leveled champion becomes myField-1. Final damage 3 = Steel Halberd base 1 + WARRIOR Class Bonus 1 (Jin is WARRIOR) + this ability's +1 POWER. Status stays 2 (awake) post-attack instead of resting, confirming WakeupCard fired.

rulesClauses: Jin Lineage (must be leveled from a previous level Jin champion).
On Enter: this card's next attack this turn gets +1 POWER and has On Attack: Wake up this card.
